career_ladder.note: Civil Excise Officers serve in the Excise Department of the Government of Kerala to enforce liquor laws, anti-narcotics regulations (NDPS Act), and border checkpost surveillance. Officers advance through Senior Civil Excise Officer (Preventive Officer), Excise Inspector, Circle Inspector of Excise, and Assistant Excise Commissioner upon completing qualifying service and clearing departmental tests conducted by Kerala PSC.

exam_scheme.note: Selection to Civil Excise Officer involves a multi-stage process: Written OMR Examination (Objective type carrying 100 marks), Physical Measurement Test (PMT), Physical Efficiency Test (PET - National 1-star standard), and Medical Examination. Final district-wise ranked lists are prepared strictly on the basis of marks scored in the Written OMR Examination among candidates who qualify the physical and medical stages.

financial_package.note: Civil Excise Officers in the Kerala Excise Department are remunerated under the Kerala State 11th Pay Revision (G.O.(P) No. 27/2021/Fin) at Pay Scale ₹27,900 - ₹63,700 with entry basic pay of ₹27,900.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Kerala PSC Gazette Notification Cat. No. 538/2019 & Kerala Excise Department Pay Rules
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Kerala State 11th Pay Revision entry basic pay of ₹27,900 with standard 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025, ₹16,182) plus House Rent Allowance (Class A Corporation ₹2,790, Class B Municipalities ₹1,900, Class C Panchayats ₹1,300), Uniform allowance (₹1,000/month), and Risk/Border Checkpost allowance; net in-hand reflects statutory deductions for National Pension System (NPS, 10% on Basic+DA = ₹4,408), MEDISEP health insurance (₹500/month), State Life Insurance (SLI), and Professional Tax.
official_perks: Government barracks or departmental quarters allotment in district excise offices and border checkposts
Annual uniform maintenance grant and kit allowance by Excise Department
Cashless medical hospitalization coverage under Kerala Government MEDISEP scheme
Special enforcement risk allowance during anti-narcotics and raid operations
Onam festival bonus / advance and departmental welfare fund benefits
